item.summary: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today addressed the concluding ceremony of the Chhattisgarh Rajyotsav in Raipur. On this occasion, Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Shri Vishnu Deo Sai and Deputy Chief Minister Shri Vijay Sharma, along with several other dignitaries, were present.
item.title: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit Shah addresses the closing ceremony of the Chhattisgarh Rajyotsav in Raipur today
